title: Joining Stanford University as a Visiting Researcher
description: Thrilled to announce that I'll be joining the Mignot Lab at Stanford this June. I’ll be spending six months as a Visiting Student Researcher, collaborating on cutting-edge sleep and neuro-science research.

title: New Publication: AlphaGrad in IEEE JBHI
description: Our paper on AlphaGrad, a novel normalized gradient descent approach for multi-loss EEG classification, has been accepted by the IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics. This work explores more adaptive ways to handle complex motor imagery data.

title: Presenting at EMBC 2022 | Glasgow
description: Traveled to Scotland to present our poster, "Towards Asynchronous Motor Imagery EEG Classification," at the 44th Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society. A fantastic opportunity to discuss the future of real-time BCI systems.
